description: This file implements the 'Label' class and related functions for handling dependency labels in a build system, including parsing, resolving, and generating user-visible label names.

classes.name: Label
classes.description: Represents a build dependency label, including directory, name, and optional toolchain info.

methods.name: Label
methods.description: Constructor with directory, name, toolchain directory, and toolchain name.

methods.name: Label
methods.description: Constructor with directory and name only.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Parses a string value into a Label object, resolving relative paths and toolchains.

methods.name: GetToolchainLabel
methods.description: Returns a Label representing the associated toolchain.

methods.name: GetWithNoToolchain
methods.description: Returns a Label without toolchain info.

methods.name: GetUserVisibleName
methods.description: Generates a user-visible string representation of the label, optionally including toolchain info.
